latency.note: actual measured wall time in this environment; no SLA is implied

provenance.weather: coarse province-point daily (and 6 h block) archive aggregated to target day - 2; not station-level, not observed at the event; missing for future dates -> routed to the core component
provenance.aadt: annual DOH survey-point proxy from the latest vintage available before the target year; not live traffic
provenance.geometry: current qualified DOH 2000 m segment snapshot applied retrospectively; event datum/linkage assumptions of notebooks 18/19
provenance.bank_calendar: bank-holiday flag is known only where the as-of calendar covers the date; unknown stays missing (native HGB NaN handling, never imputed as 0)
provenance.labels: 30-day label availability is a research assumption, not a verified publication delay

caveats: Expected SELECTED+LINKED recorded-count rate per segment and horizon; not an individual accident probability, not per-vehicle risk; never sum into a route probability.
2024/25 are PREVIOUSLY SEEN diagnostics; target dates after 2025-12-31 are research scenarios with no observed ground truth.
Colour is relative to the 2022-23 OOF reference density of the selected policy; 'base' (lowest band) is NOT safe.
Only the 3105 qualified DOH segments are supported; other roads are outside coverage (no snapping, no fake zero).
Research readiness only: production_ready is false; nothing is deployed.
